notes: Head of the מְזוּזֹת unit moved from *posts* to *door* under rule 31: the subtraction test leaves *posts* naming any post, and the tie-break — whether the ASV ever writes that class noun alone for the word — is not met, מְזוּזָה being rendered *door-posts* or *side-posts* throughout. Rule 31's listed תִּמֹרָה → *palm trees* is the direct precedent.
Edges are unchanged: the supplied *the* stays on the construct under rule 29 and the *of* on the rectum under rule 19.
